### C5: AI Code Volume Statistic Source Confusion

**Status: RESOLVED** — Removed incorrect [7] citation; now reads "industry reports estimate."

**Location:**
- analysis.md, line 9: "current estimates place AI-generated code at 30-41% of all code produced [7][27]"

**Issue:** Citation [7] analyzes 470 PRs (320 AI, 150 human) - this is 68% AI in the sample, not 30-41%. Citation [27] is a survey report.

**Verification against citations:**
- [7]: 320/470 = 68% AI PRs in sample (not 30-41%)
- [27]: Survey of 200 SRE/DevOps leaders

**Expected:** The 30-41% figure should trace to [27] or a discovery agent finding, not [7].

**Actual:** Both [7] and [27] are cited.

**Grade:** FAIL - Citation [7] does not support the 30-41% claim. This appears to be from discovery agents (see industry-practices.md line 46: "41% of all code is AI-generated (2026 SoftwareReviews)").

**Correction needed:** Replace "[7][27]" with "[27] and industry reports" or cite the specific discovery source.

### M6: SAST Miss Rate Calculation

**Status:** OPEN

**Location:**
- analysis.md, line 63: "97.8% [2]"
- static-analysis-effectiveness.md, line 22: "**97.8% (88/90)** of formally Z3-proven vulnerabilities"

**Formula verification:** 88/90 = 0.9777... = 97.78% ≈ 97.8%

## Methodology

This review was conducted without access to the original research session. All files were read independently and cross-referenced for:

- Numerical consistency (exact matches, rounding policies)
- Citation accuracy (spot-checked 100% of citations in key tables; 50%+ elsewhere)
- Formula validity (recalculated all derived percentages)
- Completeness (traced claims to sources)
- Contradiction detection (flagged conflicts, verified resolutions)
- Estimation markers (checked for "(est.)" or tilde notation)
- Caveat presence (verified limitations sections exist)
- Cross-reference links (validated all relative paths)

**Limitation:** This review cannot verify the accuracy of data extraction from the original URLs. It validates only internal consistency across the markdown files.
